properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 110 sites are math/rand / math/rand/v2 imports in *_test.go files (field-element, point and message test inputs); the only non-test matches in the tree are internal/generator *.tmpl templates that generate those test files. No security-relevant randomness: production paths use crypto/rand (ALG-80605930). Test-only usage, kept as posture record.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 curve implementation shipped by the library: G1 group ops (g1.go), ECDSA sign/verify (ecdsa/), hash-to-curve SSWU (RFC 9380, expand_message_xmd over SHA-256), marshaling, multiexp; registered as ecc.SECP256K1 (ecc/ecc.go:32). ECDLP over secp256k1 is Shor-vulnerable — every secp256k1 key/signature falls to a CRQC; signature migration ML-DSA-65. Changeable here (first-party code) but the curve API is consumed by gnark and blockchain stacks.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256r1 (NIST P-256) curve implementation: G1 ops, ECDSA sign/verify, hash-to-curve SSWU, marshaling, multiexp, plus a Cardano-specific variant (cardano.go) and an internal fptower. Registered as ecc.SECP256R1 (ecc/ecc.go:34). ECDLP Shor-vulnerable; ECDSA-P256 migration target ML-DSA-65.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: blake2b (golang.org/x/crypto) is the hash inside every EdDSA implementation — key/blinding-factor derivation via blake2b.Sum512 (e.g. ecc/bls12-377/twistededwards/eddsa/eddsa.go:144) — and SIS key-material derivation (fr/sis/sis.go:17). BLAKE2b itself is Grover-only exposure (not Shor-broken); the signatures it feeds are.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: x/crypto/sha3 Keccak usage: every site inspected (fr/mimc/mimc.go:255, fr/poseidon2/poseidon2.go:83, ...) is sha3.NewLegacyKeccak256() — Keccak-256 with the pre-FIPS (Ethereum-style) padding — used to derive MiMC/Poseidon2 round constants. The SHA-3 match is real; note the variant is legacy Keccak-256, not FIPS SHA3-256.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-declaration tier of the same SHA-3/Keccak asset: golang.org/x/crypto v0.57.0 (go.mod require) provides the x/crypto/sha3 package whose 20 code sites are inventoried under ALG-052c24b2. Merged so the CBOM carries one SHA-3 entry with both the dependency origin and the use sites.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHAKE128 is a capability of the declared dependency golang.org/x/crypto v0.57.0 (x/crypto/sha3 NewShake128). No call site in first-party code: hash-to-curve uses expand_message_xmd over SHA-256 (field/hash/hashutils.go), not the XOF mode. Recorded per the dependency inventory — the build ships the algorithm whether or not this application calls it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHAKE256 is a capability of the declared dependency golang.org/x/crypto v0.57.0 (x/crypto/sha3 NewShake256). No first-party call site found (grep for Shake/XOF across *.go: only expand_message_xmd references). Available in the shipped library; usage would come via gnark circuits or future XOF-mode hash-to-curve.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto/rand (Go CSPRNG: getrandom/ChaCha20-based) is the library's randomness source in production paths — fp/fr element.go SetRandom, ecdsa.go key/nonce generation — plus test setup (183 sites). Quantum-safe RNG; the correct primitive for key/nonce generation. Resolves the "?" rating: this is a strength, not a weakness.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-declaration tier of the BLAKE2b asset: blake2b is a subpackage of the declared golang.org/x/crypto v0.57.0 and is imported/used at the 36 sites inventoried under ALG-84de5a3e (EdDSA key derivation, SIS). Merged so the CBOM carries one BLAKE2b entry covering dependency origin and use sites.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: github.com/miekg/dns v1.0.14 appears only as a go.mod-hash checksum entry (go.sum:194) — not in go.mod's require lists and not imported by any first-party file (grep across the tree: go.sum only). Latent transitive toolchain artifact. miekg/dns implements DNSSEC validation (RSA/ECDSA/Ed25519 signature verification); no DNSSEC code path exists in this repo. Kept so the CBOM reflects the build's full dependency surface.
